// WORK-only optional private producer. No automatic registration/mux/route/config.
import {ApiCollectorCore} from './api-collector-core.mjs';
import {isOwnedRecurringRegistry,isOwnedBasicPreparation} from './item-recurring-registry.mjs';
import {sha256,parseStrictJson} from './api-price-item-dto.mjs';
import {B,need,integer,enc,encode,eq,exact,source,scope,project,compile,manifest,pointer,pageRows,basicResult,hash} from './api-basic-current-contract.mjs';
import {basicPool,readBasic,putBasic} from './api-basic-current-storage.mjs';
const CAPTURES=new WeakSet(),str=b=>new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(b),PK=B.prefix+'current.json';
export class BasicCurrentOwner{
 constructor(ctx,core,registry,{enabled=false,isEnabled=()=>true,epoch,waitMs=B.actionMs,captureWaitMs=B.actionMs,monotonic=()=>performance.now()}={}){
  this.enabled=enabled===true;if(!this.enabled)return;need(core instanceof ApiCollectorCore&&core.ctx===ctx&&isOwnedRecurringRegistry(registry,ctx)&&registry.core===core,'basic_same_owner');this.ctx=ctx;this.core=core;this.registry=registry;this.isEnabled=isEnabled;this.waitMs=waitMs;this.captureWaitMs=captureWaitMs;this.mono=monotonic;need(integer(waitMs,1,B.actionMs)&&integer(captureWaitMs,1,B.actionMs),'basic_deadline');const g=core.config();this.scope=Object.freeze(scope({grantReference:g.grantReference,roundReference:g.probeRound,epoch}));this.bucket=core.env.API_RAW_RECEIPTS;need(this.bucket&&typeof this.bucket.get==='function'&&typeof this.bucket.put==='function','basic_bucket');this.pool=basicPool(ctx,this.bucket);
  core.sql.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS basic_control(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,owner_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,action_token TEXT,retry_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,archive_json TEXT,archive_sha TEXT,last_archive TEXT,last_lane TEXT,last_result TEXT,missing_json TEXT,mux_turn TEXT)');core.sql.exec('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO basic_control(id,scope_json)VALUES(1,?)',JSON.stringify(this.scope));need(this.control().scope_json===JSON.stringify(this.scope),'basic_migration_required');
  core.sql.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS basic_generations(gid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_json TEXT NOT NULL,body_sha TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,phase TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT,manifest_raw TEXT,manifest_sha TEXT,pointer_raw TEXT,cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,claim INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,owner_epoch INTEGER,lease_until INTEGER,base_etag TEXT,base_hash TEXT)');core.sql.exec('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS basic_live_role ON basic_generations(role) WHERE role IN (\'pending\',\'active\',\'current\',\'recovery\')');core.sql.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS basic_pages(gid TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,sha TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(gid,ordinal))');
  core.sql.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET owner_epoch=owner_epoch+1 WHERE id=1');this.ownerEpoch=this.control().owner_epoch;this.revoked=false;
 }
 row(q,...a){return this.core.row(q,...a);}exec(q,...a){return this.core.sql.exec(q,...a);}control(){return this.row('SELECT * FROM basic_control WHERE id=1');}
 get active(){if(!this.enabled||this.revoked)return false;try{const g=this.core.config(),c=this.control();const okay=this.isEnabled()===true&&g.enabled===true&&g.grantReference===this.scope.grantReference&&g.probeRound===this.scope.roundReference&&this.core.env.API_RAW_RECEIPTS===this.bucket&&this.registry.active&&c.owner_epoch===this.ownerEpoch&&c.scope_json===JSON.stringify(this.scope)&&this.row('SELECT auth_stopped FROM api_control WHERE id=1')?.auth_stopped===0;if(!okay)this.revoked=true;return okay;}catch{this.revoked=true;return false;}}
 guard(c=null,j=null){need(this.active,'basic_paused');if(j){const r=this.row('SELECT role,phase,claim,owner_epoch,lease_until,source_json,body_sha FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=?',j.gid);need(r?.role==='active'&&r.phase===j.phase&&r.claim===j.claim&&r.owner_epoch===this.ownerEpoch&&r.lease_until>this.core.clock()&&r.source_json===j.source_json&&r.body_sha===j.body_sha,'basic_claim');this.sourceFence(JSON.parse(j.source_json));}if(c)need(this.mono()<c.deadline,'basic_action_deadline');}
 sourceFence(s){source(s);need(s.grantReference===this.scope.grantReference&&s.roundReference===this.scope.roundReference&&Date.parse(s.capturedAt)<=this.core.clock(),'basic_owned_source');this.registry.owned({receipt_key:s.receiptKey,job_key:s.jobKey,source_attempt:s.attempt,raw_sha:s.rawSha,request_at:Date.parse(s.requestAt),operation:'prices'});}
 get capturePending(){return this.enabled&&CAPTURES.has(this.ctx);}
 historyCount(){return this.row("SELECT COUNT(*)n FROM basic_generations WHERE role='history'").n;}
 retainedBytes(){return this.row('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(source_json AS BLOB))+length(CAST(body_sha AS BLOB))+length(CAST(gid AS BLOB))+length(CAST(role AS BLOB))+length(CAST(phase AS BLOB))+COALESCE(length(CAST(manifest_sha AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(body AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(manifest_raw AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(pointer_raw AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(base_etag AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(base_hash AS BLOB)),0)),0)n FROM basic_generations').n+this.row('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(body AS BLOB))+length(CAST(sha AS BLOB))+length(CAST(gid AS BLOB))),0)n FROM basic_pages').n+this.row('SELECT length(CAST(scope_json AS BLOB))+COALESCE(length(CAST(archive_json AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(archive_sha AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(last_archive AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(action_token AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(last_lane AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(last_result AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(missing_json AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(mux_turn AS BLOB)),0)n FROM basic_control').n;}
 checkCapacity(){need(this.retainedBytes()<=B.sqlBytes&&this.historyCount()<=B.history,'basic_sql_capacity');}
 async capture(input){if(!this.active)return{status:'basic_off'};need(isOwnedBasicPreparation(input,this.registry,this.ctx,this.core),'basic_capture_phase');const missing=source({receiptKey:input.job.receipt_key,jobKey:input.job.job_key,attempt:input.job.source_attempt,rawSha:input.job.raw_sha,requestAt:input.envelope.requestStartedAt,capturedAt:input.envelope.capturedAt,grantReference:this.scope.grantReference,roundReference:this.scope.roundReference});if(CAPTURES.has(this.ctx)){this.recordMissing(missing);return{status:'basic_capture_busy'};}CAPTURES.add(this.ctx);const cancel={value:false},task=this.prepareCapture(input,cancel);input=null;let timer;try{const result=await Promise.race([task,new Promise(resolve=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>{cancel.value=true;resolve({status:'basic_capture_pending_not_admitted'});},this.captureWaitMs);})]);if(result.status==='basic_capture_pending_not_admitted')this.recordMissing(missing);return result;}catch(error){try{this.recordMissing(missing);}catch{}throw error;}finally{clearTimeout(timer);task.finally(()=>CAPTURES.delete(this.ctx)).catch(()=>{});}}
 recordMissing(s){if(!this.active)return;this.sourceFence(s);const body=JSON.stringify(s);need(enc.encode(body).length<=B.metadataBytes,'basic_missing_bound');this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(()=>{this.guard();this.sourceFence(s);const old=this.control().missing_json,m=old?JSON.parse(old):null;if(!m||s.capturedAt>m.capturedAt||s.capturedAt===m.capturedAt&&s.attempt>m.attempt)this.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET missing_json=? WHERE id=1',body);this.sourceFence(s);this.guard();});}
 newerKnown(s){const rows=this.exec("SELECT source_json FROM basic_generations WHERE role IN ('pending','active')").toArray().map(r=>JSON.parse(r.source_json)),missing=this.control().missing_json;if(missing)rows.push(JSON.parse(missing));return rows.some(r=>r.capturedAt>s.capturedAt||r.capturedAt===s.capturedAt&&r.attempt>s.attempt);}

 async prepareCapture(input,cancel){const deadline=this.mono()+this.captureWaitMs;try{const job=Object.freeze({...input.job});this.registry.fence(job);const itemCount=input.priceSnapshot.summary.itemCount,body=project(input.priceSnapshot,{registry:this.registry,ctx:this.ctx}),s=source({receiptKey:job.receipt_key,jobKey:job.job_key,attempt:job.source_attempt,rawSha:job.raw_sha,requestAt:input.envelope.requestStartedAt,capturedAt:input.envelope.capturedAt,grantReference:this.scope.grantReference,roundReference:this.scope.roundReference});need(input.priceSnapshot.summary.source.retrievedAt===s.capturedAt&&input.priceSnapshot.summary.rawBodySha256===s.rawSha,'basic_capture_binding');const sourceJson=JSON.stringify(s);need(enc.encode(sourceJson).length<=B.metadataBytes,'basic_source_bytes');this.sourceFence(s);input=null;const bodySha=await sha256(enc.encode(body)),gid=await sha256(encode({source:s,scope:this.scope}));need(!cancel.value,'basic_capture_cancelled');this.guard();this.registry.fence(job);this.sourceFence(s);need(this.mono()<deadline,'basic_capture_deadline');return this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(()=>{this.guard();this.registry.fence(job);this.sourceFence(s);const existing=this.row('SELECT source_json,body_sha FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=?',gid);if(existing){need(existing.source_json===sourceJson&&existing.body_sha===bodySha,'basic_idempotence');return{status:'basic_already_captured'};}const latest=this.exec('SELECT source_json FROM basic_generations').toArray().map(r=>JSON.parse(r.source_json)).sort((a,b)=>a.capturedAt.localeCompare(b.capturedAt)||a.attempt-b.attempt).at(-1);if(latest&&(s.capturedAt<latest.capturedAt||s.capturedAt===latest.capturedAt&&s.attempt<=latest.attempt))return{status:'basic_stale_capture'};need(this.historyCount()<B.history,'basic_history_capacity');this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET role='history',phase='coalesced_not_published',body=NULL WHERE role='pending'");this.exec("INSERT INTO basic_generations(gid,source_json,body_sha,role,phase,body)VALUES(?,?,?,'pending','compile',?)",gid,sourceJson,bodySha,body);const missed=this.control().missing_json;if(missed){const m=JSON.parse(missed);if(s.capturedAt>m.capturedAt||s.capturedAt===m.capturedAt&&s.attempt>=m.attempt)this.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET missing_json=NULL WHERE id=1');}this.checkCapacity();need(this.row('SELECT body_sha,body FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=?',gid)?.body===body,'basic_capture_ack');this.registry.fence(job);this.sourceFence(s);this.guard();need(this.mono()<deadline,'basic_capture_deadline');return{status:'basic_pending_captured',itemCount};});}finally{input=null;}}
 job(){return this.row("SELECT gid,body_sha,role,phase,manifest_sha,cursor,claim,owner_epoch,lease_until,base_etag,base_hash,CASE WHEN length(CAST(source_json AS BLOB))<=4096 THEN source_json ELSE NULL END source_json,CASE WHEN length(CAST(body AS BLOB))<=8388608 THEN body ELSE NULL END body,CASE WHEN length(CAST(manifest_raw AS BLOB))<=65536 THEN manifest_raw ELSE NULL END manifest_raw,CASE WHEN length(CAST(pointer_raw AS BLOB))<=4096 THEN pointer_raw ELSE NULL END pointer_raw FROM basic_generations WHERE role='active'");}
 claim(c){return this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(()=>{this.guard(c);let j=this.job();if(!j){const p=this.row("SELECT gid FROM basic_generations WHERE role='pending'");if(!p)return null;this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET role='active' WHERE gid=?",p.gid);j=this.job();}need(j.phase!=='review','basic_job_review');if(j.lease_until>this.core.clock())return null;this.sourceFence(JSON.parse(j.source_json));this.exec('UPDATE basic_generations SET claim=claim+1,owner_epoch=?,lease_until=? WHERE gid=?',this.ownerEpoch,this.core.clock()+B.leaseMs,j.gid);const next={...j,claim:j.claim+1,owner_epoch:this.ownerEpoch,lease_until:this.core.clock()+B.leaseMs};this.guard(c,next);return next;});}
 ack(c,j,fn){return this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(()=>{this.guard(c,j);fn();const r=this.row('SELECT claim,owner_epoch,role FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=?',j.gid);need(r?.claim===j.claim&&r.owner_epoch===this.ownerEpoch&&['active','current'].includes(r.role),'basic_ack');this.checkCapacity();this.sourceFence(JSON.parse(j.source_json));this.guard(c);this.exec('UPDATE basic_generations SET lease_until=NULL WHERE gid=?',j.gid);this.exec("UPDATE basic_control SET retry_at=0,last_result='progress' WHERE id=1");const admitted=this.row('SELECT source_json,body_sha,pointer_raw,manifest_raw,manifest_sha FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=?',j.gid);need(admitted?.source_json===j.source_json&&admitted.body_sha===j.body_sha,'basic_final_metadata');if(j.phase!=='compile')need(admitted.pointer_raw===j.pointer_raw&&admitted.manifest_raw===j.manifest_raw&&admitted.manifest_sha===j.manifest_sha,'basic_final_graph');this.sourceFence(JSON.parse(j.source_json));this.guard(c);});}
 async publish(c,j,beforeIO){const fence=()=>this.guard(c,j);await beforeIO(this.core.clock()+B.leaseMs);fence();
  if(j.phase==='compile'){need(typeof j.body==='string'&&enc.encode(j.body).length<=B.totalBytes&&await sha256(enc.encode(j.body))===j.body_sha,'basic_capture_hash');fence();const g=await compile(j.body,JSON.parse(j.source_json),this.scope);fence();need(g.pointer.generation===j.gid,'basic_generation');this.ack(c,j,()=>{this.exec('UPDATE basic_generations SET body=NULL,manifest_raw=?,manifest_sha=?,pointer_raw=?,phase=\'write\',cursor=0 WHERE gid=?',str(g.manifestRaw),g.manifestSha,str(g.pointerRaw),j.gid);g.pages.forEach((p,i)=>this.exec('INSERT INTO basic_pages VALUES(?,?,?,?)',j.gid,i,p.sha,str(p.raw)));});return{status:'basic_graph_staged'};}
  need(typeof j.manifest_raw==='string'&&enc.encode(j.manifest_raw).length<=B.manifestBytes&&typeof j.pointer_raw==='string'&&enc.encode(j.pointer_raw).length<=B.pointerBytes,'basic_stored_graph_bounds');const m=manifest(parseStrictJson(enc.encode(j.manifest_raw))),p=pointer(parseStrictJson(enc.encode(j.pointer_raw)));need(await sha256(enc.encode(j.manifest_raw))===j.manifest_sha&&p.manifestSha===j.manifest_sha&&p.manifestBytes===enc.encode(j.manifest_raw).length&&p.generation===j.gid&&eq(m.source,p.source)&&eq(m.scope,p.scope)&&eq(m.scope,this.scope)&&m.generation===j.gid&&eq(p.source,JSON.parse(j.source_json))&&await sha256(encode({source:p.source,scope:this.scope}))===j.gid,'basic_stored_graph');fence();
  if(j.phase==='write'){const d=m.pages[j.cursor];if(d){const batch=m.pages.slice(j.cursor,j.cursor+B.batchObjects);need(batch.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x.bytes,0)<=B.batchBytes,'basic_batch_bytes');for(const [offset,item]of batch.entries()){fence();const page=this.row('SELECT sha,CASE WHEN length(CAST(body AS BLOB))<=262144 THEN body ELSE NULL END body FROM basic_pages WHERE gid=? AND ordinal=?',j.gid,j.cursor+offset);need(page&&typeof page.body==='string'&&page.sha===item.sha&&enc.encode(page.body).length===item.bytes&&await sha256(enc.encode(page.body))===item.sha,'basic_staged_page');pageRows(enc.encode(page.body),m,item);await putBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'objects/'+item.sha+'.json',enc.encode(page.body),fence);}this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec('UPDATE basic_generations SET cursor=cursor+? WHERE gid=?',batch.length,j.gid));return{status:'basic_pages_written',objects:batch.length};}await putBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'objects/'+j.manifest_sha+'.json',enc.encode(j.manifest_raw),fence);this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET phase='replay',cursor=-1 WHERE gid=?",j.gid));return{status:'basic_manifest_written'};}
  if(j.phase==='replay'){if(j.cursor===-1){await readBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'objects/'+j.manifest_sha+'.json',{max:B.manifestBytes,expectedBytes:p.manifestBytes,expectedSha:j.manifest_sha,fence});this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec('UPDATE basic_generations SET cursor=0 WHERE gid=?',j.gid));return{status:'basic_manifest_replayed'};}const d=m.pages[j.cursor];if(d){const batch=m.pages.slice(j.cursor,j.cursor+B.batchObjects);need(batch.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x.bytes,0)<=B.batchBytes,'basic_batch_bytes');for(const item of batch){fence();const got=await readBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'objects/'+item.sha+'.json',{max:B.pageBytes,expectedSha:item.sha,expectedBytes:item.bytes,fence});pageRows(got.raw,m,item);}this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec('UPDATE basic_generations SET cursor=cursor+? WHERE gid=?',batch.length,j.gid));return{status:'basic_pages_replayed',objects:batch.length};}const all=[],rows=[];for(const [index,x]of this.exec('SELECT CASE WHEN length(CAST(body AS BLOB))<=262144 THEN body ELSE NULL END body FROM basic_pages WHERE gid=? ORDER BY ordinal',j.gid).toArray().entries()){need(typeof x.body==='string','basic_page_bound');const raw=enc.encode(x.body),d=m.pages[index];need(d&&raw.length===d.bytes&&await sha256(raw)===d.sha,'basic_final_page_hash');fence();for(const r of pageRows(raw,m,d)){all.push(r[0]);rows.push(r);}}need(all.length===m.itemCount&&await sha256(encode(all))===m.membershipSha&&await sha256(encode(rows))===j.body_sha,'basic_membership_hash');fence();this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET phase='base' WHERE gid=?",j.gid));return{status:'basic_graph_replayed'};}
  if(j.phase==='base'){const base=await readBasic(this.bucket,PK,{max:B.pointerBytes,allowMissing:true,fence}),known=this.row("SELECT pointer_raw FROM basic_generations WHERE role='current'");need(base?known&&str(base.raw)===known.pointer_raw:!known,'basic_foreign_head');need(!base||typeof base.etag==='string'&&base.etag.length>0&&base.etag.length<=256,'basic_base_etag');const baseHash=base?await sha256(base.raw):null;fence();this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET phase='pointer',base_etag=?,base_hash=? WHERE gid=?",base?.etag??null,baseHash,j.gid));return{status:'basic_base_bound'};}
  if(j.phase==='pointer'){const current=this.row("SELECT source_json FROM basic_generations WHERE role='current'");if(current){const x=JSON.parse(current.source_json);need(p.source.capturedAt>x.capturedAt||p.source.capturedAt===x.capturedAt&&p.source.attempt>x.attempt,'basic_monotonic_head');}await this.bucket.put(PK,enc.encode(j.pointer_raw),{onlyIf:j.base_etag===null?{etagDoesNotMatch:'*'}:{etagMatches:j.base_etag},httpMetadata:{contentType:'application/json'}});fence();this.ack(c,j,()=>this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET phase='readback' WHERE gid=?",j.gid));return{status:'basic_pointer_written'};}
  if(j.phase==='readback'){const got=await readBasic(this.bucket,PK,{max:B.pointerBytes,expectedBytes:enc.encode(j.pointer_raw).length,expectedSha:await sha256(enc.encode(j.pointer_raw)),fence});need(str(got.raw)===j.pointer_raw,'basic_readback');this.ack(c,j,()=>{need(this.historyCount()<B.history,'basic_history_capacity');this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET role='history',phase='retained_immutable' WHERE role='recovery'");this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET role='recovery' WHERE role='current'");this.exec("UPDATE basic_generations SET role='current',phase='committed' WHERE gid=?",j.gid);this.exec('DELETE FROM basic_pages WHERE gid=?',j.gid);});return{status:'basic_current_readback_confirmed',capturedAt:p.source.capturedAt};}throw Error('basic_phase');
 }
 validateArchive(body){need(typeof body==='string'&&enc.encode(body).length<=65536,'basic_archive_capacity');const v=parseStrictJson(enc.encode(body));exact(v,['schemaVersion','kind','scope','previous','rows']);need(v.schemaVersion===1&&v.kind==='private_basic_history'&&eq(v.scope,this.scope)&&(v.previous===null||hash(v.previous))&&Array.isArray(v.rows)&&integer(v.rows.length,1,8),'basic_archive_shape');const seen=new Set();for(const r of v.rows){exact(r,['gid','source_json','body_sha','manifest_sha','pointer_raw','phase']);need(hash(r.gid)&&hash(r.body_sha)&&!seen.has(r.gid)&&typeof r.source_json==='string'&&enc.encode(r.source_json).length<=B.metadataBytes,'basic_archive_row');seen.add(r.gid);const src=source(JSON.parse(r.source_json));this.sourceFence(src);if(r.phase==='coalesced_not_published')need(r.manifest_sha===null&&r.pointer_raw===null,'basic_archive_unpublished');else{need(r.phase==='retained_immutable'&&hash(r.manifest_sha)&&typeof r.pointer_raw==='string'&&enc.encode(r.pointer_raw).length<=B.pointerBytes,'basic_archive_published');const p=pointer(parseStrictJson(enc.encode(r.pointer_raw)));need(p.generation===r.gid&&p.manifestSha===r.manifest_sha&&eq(p.source,src)&&eq(p.scope,this.scope),'basic_archive_pointer');}}return v;}

 async archive(c,beforeIO){this.guard(c);let ctl=this.control();if(!ctl.archive_json){const rows=this.exec("SELECT gid,source_json,body_sha,manifest_sha,pointer_raw,phase FROM basic_generations WHERE role='history' ORDER BY gid LIMIT 8").toArray();if(!rows.length)return{status:'basic_no_history'};const record={schemaVersion:1,kind:'private_basic_history',scope:this.scope,previous:ctl.last_archive,rows};const body=JSON.stringify(record);this.validateArchive(body);const digest=await sha256(enc.encode(body));this.guard(c);this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(()=>{this.guard(c);for(const r of rows)need(eq(this.row("SELECT gid,source_json,body_sha,manifest_sha,pointer_raw,phase FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=? AND role='history'",r.gid),r),'basic_archive_rebound');this.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET archive_json=?,archive_sha=? WHERE id=1',body,digest);this.checkCapacity();this.guard(c);});ctl=this.control();}const body=ctl.archive_json,digest=ctl.archive_sha;this.validateArchive(body);need(enc.encode(body).length<=65536&&hash(digest)&&await sha256(enc.encode(body))===digest,'basic_archive_hash');this.guard(c);await beforeIO(this.core.clock()+B.leaseMs);const fence=()=>{this.guard(c);this.validateArchive(body);need(this.control().archive_json===body&&this.control().archive_sha===digest,'basic_archive_rebound');};await putBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'history/'+digest+'.json',enc.encode(body),fence);await readBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'history/'+digest+'.json',{max:65536,expectedBytes:enc.encode(body).length,expectedSha:digest,fence});const rows=JSON.parse(body).rows;this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(()=>{fence();for(const r of rows){need(eq(this.row("SELECT gid,source_json,body_sha,manifest_sha,pointer_raw,phase FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=? AND role='history'",r.gid),r),'basic_archive_rebound');this.exec("DELETE FROM basic_generations WHERE gid=? AND role='history'",r.gid);}this.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET last_archive=?,archive_json=NULL,archive_sha=NULL WHERE id=1',digest);this.checkCapacity();this.validateArchive(body);this.guard(c);});return{status:'basic_history_readback_acknowledged',rows:rows.length};}
 nextDue(){if(!this.enabled||!this.active)return null;const c=this.control();if(this.pool.task||c.action_token)return Math.max(c.retry_at,this.core.clock()+B.backoffMs);const job=this.job();return job||this.row("SELECT 1 n FROM basic_generations WHERE role='pending'")||this.historyCount()?Math.max(c.retry_at,job?.lease_until??0,this.core.clock()):null;}
 async action(kind,fn){if(!this.active)return{status:'basic_off'};const ctl=this.control();if(this.pool.task||ctl.action_token)return{status:'basic_physical_or_unknown_hold'};if(ctl.retry_at>this.core.clock())return{status:'basic_backoff'};const c={deadline:this.mono()+this.waitMs},token=String(this.ownerEpoch)+':'+String(this.core.clock())+':'+String(ctl.owner_epoch)+':'+kind;this.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET action_token=?,last_lane=? WHERE id=1',token,kind);const task=(async()=>{try{this.guard(c);return await fn(c);}catch(error){if(error?.basicPhysicalUnknown===true)this.pool.unknown=true;if(this.active)this.exec("UPDATE basic_control SET retry_at=?,last_result='action_hold' WHERE id=1",this.core.clock()+B.backoffMs);return{status:this.pool.unknown?'basic_physical_unknown_hold':'basic_action_hold'};}finally{if(!this.pool.unknown)this.exec('UPDATE basic_control SET action_token=NULL WHERE id=1 AND action_token=?',token);}})();this.pool.task=task;let timer;try{return await Promise.race([task,new Promise(resolve=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>resolve({status:'basic_action_pending'}),this.waitMs);})]);}finally{clearTimeout(timer);task.finally(()=>{if(this.pool.task===task)this.pool.task=null;}).catch(()=>{});}}
 drainOne(beforeIO){need(typeof beforeIO==='function','basic_recovery_hook');if(!this.enabled)return Promise.resolve({status:'basic_off'});const c=this.control(),archive=!!c.archive_json||this.historyCount()>=16&&c.last_lane!=='archive'||!this.job()&&!this.row("SELECT 1 n FROM basic_generations WHERE role='pending'")&&this.historyCount()>0;return this.action(archive?'archive':'publish',async window=>archive?this.archive(window,beforeIO):((j)=>j?this.publish(window,j,beforeIO):{status:'basic_idle'})(this.claim(window)));}
 readItem(id,beforeIO){need(integer(id,1,999999999)&&typeof beforeIO==='function','basic_selected_id');return this.action('reader',async c=>{const known=this.row("SELECT gid,manifest_raw,manifest_sha,pointer_raw,source_json FROM basic_generations WHERE role='current'");need(known,'basic_no_current');const fence=()=>{this.guard(c);const now=this.row("SELECT role='current'");need(now?.gid===known.gid&&now.pointer_raw===known.pointer_raw,'basic_reader_generation');this.sourceFence(JSON.parse(known.source_json));};await beforeIO(this.core.clock()+B.leaseMs);const p=pointer(parseStrictJson(enc.encode(known.pointer_raw)));need(p.generation===known.gid&&p.manifestSha===known.manifest_sha&&eq(p.source,JSON.parse(known.source_json))&&eq(p.scope,this.scope),'basic_reader_source');await readBasic(this.bucket,PK,{max:B.pointerBytes,expectedBytes:enc.encode(known.pointer_raw).length,expectedSha:await sha256(enc.encode(known.pointer_raw)),fence});const mr=await readBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'objects/'+p.manifestSha+'.json',{max:B.manifestBytes,expectedBytes:p.manifestBytes,expectedSha:p.manifestSha,fence}),m=manifest(parseStrictJson(mr.raw));need(m.generation===known.gid&&eq(m.source,p.source)&&eq(m.scope,this.scope),'basic_reader_manifest');const d=m.pages.find(d=>id>=d.firstId&&id<=d.lastId);if(!d){fence();const retained=this.newerKnown(m.source);return{status:retained?'basic_selected_retained_absent':'basic_selected_absent',newerOwnedCapturePending:retained,reference:basicResult(m,null)};}const pr=await readBasic(this.bucket,B.prefix+'objects/'+d.sha+'.json',{max:B.pageBytes,expectedSha:d.sha,expectedBytes:d.bytes,fence}),rows=pageRows(pr.raw,m,d),row=rows.find(r=>r[0]===id)??null;fence();const retained=this.newerKnown(m.source);return{status:retained?(row?'basic_selected_retained':'basic_selected_retained_absent'):(row?'basic_selected_ready':'basic_selected_absent'),newerOwnedCapturePending:retained,reference:basicResult(m,row)};});}
